name: master-session
description: A validator session (/master-session:start) that briefs worker sessions (/master-session:run), persona subagents (/master-session:run-sub) and workflows (/master-session:workflow), verifies what they deliver and merges it, with a live status pane (/master-session:info), a band above the prompt and six personas (implementer, refactorer, reviewer, QA verifier, design checker, researcher), each a skill and an agent.
